Co-taught by Tara Eschroender and Beth Erngren of West Asheville Y...

rows.title: Othello
rows.summary: A high-stakes Shakespearean tragedy where Iago’s whispered manipulation turns Othello and Desdemona’s secret marriage into jealousy, doubt, and betrayal. Venice and Cyprus settings frame an intense arc of love, deception, and collapsing trust.
rows.description: Othello, directed by Stephanie Hickling Beckman. June 5–27, 2026 Passion, jealousy, and deceit take center stage in one of Shakespeare’s most gripping plays. Othello, a brilliant general, secretly marries Desdemona, but their happiness fuels envy in his cunning ensign, Iago. With whispered lies and clever manipulation, Iago turns love into doubt and trust into turmoil. Set against the vibrant worlds of Venice and Cyprus, this tale of love and betrayal explores how even the strongest hearts can be undone by rumor. Bold, emotional, and timeless, Othello keeps audiences on edge until the final cu...

rows.title: Romeo & Juliet
rows.summary: Shakespeare’s star crossed romance turns Verona into a powder keg of duels, disguises, and aching first love. Expect sweeping emotion and rapid shifts from wit to tragedy as family pride and fate collide.
rows.description: Directed by Kristi DeVille Two young lovers from feuding families fall head over heels, hoping their secret romance will bring peace to Verona. But family pride and fate have other plans. With duels, disguises, and heartfelt passion, Shakespeare’s unforgettable love story blends comedy, tragedy, and the thrill of first love. It’s timeless, emotional, and proof that even in heartbreak, love remains the greatest adventure of all.

rows.title: Taming of the Shrew
rows.summary: Fast-paced Shakespearean romp packed with sharp banter, mistaken identities, and chaotic comic twists as Petruchio takes on the fiery Katherina in lively Padua. Expect big laughs, clever reversals, and sparks of romance.
rows.description: July 3–August 1 Directed by Jason Williams In lively Padua, sweet Bianca can’t marry until her fiery sister Katherina does. Enter Petruchio, a bold suitor ready for the challenge. What follows is a fast-paced battle of wit, pride, and maybe even affection. Filled with mistaken identities, sharp banter, and plenty of comedic chaos, Shakespeare’s classic comedy explores what happens when two strong spirits collide. Expect laughter, clever twists, and just enough romance to keep everyone guessing.

rows.title: The Hope of Oz

The story follows Gale, an investigative “Witch-hunter,” on the trail of East’s assassination. Trapped in a bar with a synthetic (known as mimics), surrounded by encroaching revolutionaries, Witches, and the...

rows.title: The League of the Scarlet Pimpernel
rows.summary: Swashbuckling French Revolution drama with secret rescues, hidden identities, and a tiny red flower left as a calling card. A band of egalitarian heroes races to outwit Armand Chauvelin and a tyrannical regime as the guillotine looms.
rows.description: by Audrey Kopp The League of the Scarlet Pimpernel is a fresh spin on the classic tales penned by Baroness Orczy a century ago. During the French Revolution, a mysterious and egalitarian group risks everything to rescue the unjustly accused from the guillotine, working tirelessly to save the innocent from the machinations of a power-mad, tyrannical government. In their daring rescues, the League always leaves behind a tiny red flower as their signature. The League’s arch-enemy, Armand Chauvelin, devises a nefarious plan that could put an end to the heroic league. With danger closing in, all me...

rows.title: The Winter Ramble

rows.description: This inaugural event isn’t a fenced-in festival; it’s a three-day ramble through Hendersonville and Henderson County featuring traditional mountain music — the kind born from front porches, barns and dance halls across the Blue Ridge. Two dozen acts are set to perform. Headliners include: Grammy-winning singer/songwriter Trey Hensley; Asheville-based country-roots group Amanda Anne Platt & The Honeycutters; master fiddler and storyteller Josh Goforth; and husband-and-wife Americana duo Chatham Rabbits.

rows.title: Sourdough for Beginners

rows.title: N.C. Apple Festival

rows.description: The annual NC Apple Festival is more than just apples—it’s a celebration packed with fun for the whole family! From a bustling street fair to exciting children’s activities, delicious festival food, and live entertainment, there’s something for everyone. The North Carolina Apple Festival is proud to include 14 local apple growers in the Street Fair. You can purchase a few apples or bushels of fresh locally grown apples. Many of the growers also feature items such as fried apple pies, apple cakes, apple butter and apple cider at the Festival.

rows.title: Change of Seasons: Spring Into Ikebana
rows.summary: An ikebana exhibition highlighting the disciplined Japanese art of floral arrangement, where line, color, space, contrast, and texture shape expressive seasonal designs. Botanical materials evoke harmony with nature and a calm, contemplative mood.
rows.description: The Ikebana International Asheville Chapter will present an exhibition of ikebana, the disciplined Japanese art of floral arrangement. Through intentional use of line, color, space, contrast, and texture, these works transform plant materials into expressive designs that reflect harmony between humanity and nature, creating beauty and a sense of calm.

rows.title: Meditative Morning
rows.summary: Quiet hours in the Arboretum’s gardens and trails, with leaf blowers and mowers paused so birdsong and wind in the trees take center stage. Ideal for a self-guided, mindful morning walk with half-price parking.
rows.description: We’ve heard your valuable feedback, and now you don’t have to hear us! Beginning May 4, 2021, the period between 8 and 10 a.m. on the first Tuesday morning of every month will be reserved for “Meditative Mornings,” a pause for quiet time in our gardens and on our trails. During this time, our working garden crew will abstain from using leaf blowers, mowers and other equipment so you can be sure to enjoy the sounds of birds and the wind in the trees. Take advantage of half-price parking on the first Tuesday of every month and come out to the Arboretum to enjoy a Meditative Morning!

rows.title: Trolls: A Field Study
rows.summary: Twelve towering troll sculptures fashioned from fallen branches and wooden pallets invite tactile exploration and reflection on human life, with interactive prompts and forested pathways encouraging close-up viewing and playful discovery.
rows.description: An interactive exhibition featuring twelve troll sculptures exploring human life, crafted from materials like fallen branches and wooden pallets.

rows.title: Winter Lights

rows.title: Jeeves In Bloom
rows.summary: Fast-paced British farce as Bertie Wooster and valet Jeeves navigate matchmaking mishaps, attempted burglary, and a homicidal French chef—witty physical comedy and period charm brought to life by NC Stage Co.'s professional ensemble.
rows.description: The peaceful English countryside may never be the same after Bertie Wooster and his unflappable valet, Jeeves, pay a visit. Soon, Bertie is fending off Madeline’s amorous advances, reluctantly participating in an attempted burglary, and fleeing attacks from a homicidal French chef. With the stakes this high, the solution must lie with the one and only Jeeves!

rows.summary: A statistics obsessed insurance agent rides out a violent storm in her basement, ricocheting through memories that swing from Disney World and Best Buy to Hamlet. Darkly funny, raw storytelling reveals secrets, lies, and a hard won vision for the future.
rows.description: Statistics-obsessed insurance agent Angela races into her basement to escape an oncoming storm. rows.title: Reconnecting Through Hard Times
